content.value_statement: Building durable, real-time agents on Cloudflare Workers requires several coordinated APIs. This skill provides focused patterns for the Agents SDK and related Cloudflare services.
actual_capabilities: Guides Agent class setup, routing, persistent state, and callable RPC methods.
Explains scheduled tasks, durable workflows, queues, retries, and resumable execution.
Provides patterns for WebSocket chat, streaming responses, and server-driven messages.
Covers MCP clients, MCP servers, transports, and Cloudflare service bindings.
Documents email, webhooks, push notifications, browser automation, and voice agents.
Shows React integration with Agents SDK hooks and client connection options.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples but does not deploy or operate Cloudflare resources independently.
Experimental voice, browser, and Think APIs can change and require current Cloudflare documentation.
Examples require project-specific bindings, secrets, routes, and account configuration.
The skill does not replace application security review, authorization design, or production testing.

use_cases.title: Create a Stateful Support Agent
use_cases.description: Design a Worker agent that stores conversation state, streams responses, and reconnects clients after interruptions.

use_cases.title: Automate Durable Operations
use_cases.description: Combine schedules, workflows, queues, and retries for long-running tasks that survive Worker restarts.

use_cases.title: Expose Tools Through MCP
use_cases.description: Build and secure an MCP server that connects agent tools to Cloudflare services and internal bindings.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal Cloudflare Agent named [agent name]. Include configuration, routing, persistent state, and one callable method. Explain each required file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Agents SDK project

prompt_templates.title: Add Real-Time Chat
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend my Cloudflare Agent with streaming chat and a React client. Preserve messages across reconnects and identify the required bindings.

prompt_templates.title: Design Durable Background Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a durable process for [task]. Use schedules, workflows, queues, and retries where appropriate. Explain failure recovery and observability.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Agents SDK design for state consistency, authentication, tool approval, secret handling, retries, and deployment configuration. Recommend specific changes.

output_examples.input: Create a counter agent with persistent state and a React client.
output_examples.output: A project plan covering the Agent class, state updates, route configuration, client hook setup, and reconnection behavior.

output_examples.input: Design a scheduled report workflow with retries.
output: A schedule definition and durable workflow structure.
A retry policy with backoff and failure limits.
Observability checkpoints for each processing stage.

output_examples.input: Review an MCP agent that accesses internal tools.
output_examples.output: A focused review of transport choice, authentication, service bindings, tool permissions, error handling, and deployment requirements.

best_practices: Confirm API details against current Cloudflare documentation before implementation.
Store credentials in Cloudflare secret bindings and validate every external request.
Use durable state, retries, and observability according to each operation's failure model.
anti_patterns: Do not embed credentials, private keys, or production endpoints in source code.
Do not expose callable methods or MCP tools without authentication and authorization.
Do not assume experimental APIs remain stable across package versions.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build stateful Cloudflare Worker agents, chat applications, workflows, MCP services, scheduled tasks, and related client integrations.

faq.question: Does it create a complete deployed project?
faq.answer: It can guide project implementation, but deployment still requires Cloudflare credentials, bindings, routes, and account configuration.

faq.question: Which client frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: The references cover React hooks and the Agents SDK client for real-time connections and chat.

faq.question: Can it help with long-running tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers workflows, durable execution, queues, scheduling, retries, and recovery patterns.

faq.question: Does it support MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers MCP clients, servers, transports, authentication considerations, and service binding connections.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Store secrets in Cloudflare bindings, avoid logging them, validate signatures, and restrict access to authorized operations.
